/Ayurveda_Treatment_Neo_S.India_Cities.h.old: Situated at the base of the Nilgiri mountain range in the charming plains of Palakkad, also known as the granary of Kerala, Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village is among the first of its kind in Kerala. The area is peaceful and unspoiled, and it provides a fantastic view of the slopes, forests, streams, and rice fields. Thirty private villas, a mashup of modern and traditional South Indian architecture, are available to welcome you. They are lavish and cozy. Well-designed, tastefully furnished interiors are visually pleasing, but they pale in comparison to the expansive, picturesque exterior view. Natural walks, cobblestone walkways, and landscaped views all contribute to the allure.

/Ayurveda_Treatment_Neo_S.India_Cities.h.old: Kerala, the magical tropical land where Ayurveda originated and whose beautiful beauty captivates everyone, is home to all Ayurvedic and Yoga devotees. /about-us/.old: Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s flagship ayurvedic destination, Kairali-The Ayurvedic Healing Village, Palakkad, Kerala is one-of-its-kind of a holistic space, which offers traditional and authentic Ayurvedic therapies, treatments and medications along with Yoga and Meditation. The healing village sits at the foot of Nilgiri and Annamalai ranges (Western Ghats). Set amidst mountains, forests, fertile valley and rivers are the 30 premium villas, which are forever surrounded by the fragrance of Pala trees. In compliance with Vaastu Shastra, the villas add on to the restorative and curative ambience. The Ayurvedic Healing Village also boasts of Red Oxide flooring, a rare Valambari Conch shell and a gentle stream flowing around every villa. Yoga, Meditation, Astrology, Palmistry, nutrition, therapy, spiritual training and traditional Indian rituals (pujas) are part of the routine at the retreat. The Ayurvedic Healing Village is the epitome of Kairali’s skill in concept hospitality – a perfectly intuitive design born of timeless wisdom. Time spent at this inspiring jungle sanctuary will leave you wondering whether you are experiencing the height of modern holistic comfort, or have travelled far into India’s distant past.

/about-us/.old: Product of the New York Institute of Technology, Mr. K.R.Abishek is the youngest in the family of Ayurvedic practitioners who also has pledged to dedicate his life in the service of Ayurveda. The face of the Kairali Ayurvedic Group’s franchise division, he also heads the Training and Panchakarma Institutes in Kerala. With great achievements in expanding Kairali’s pharmaceutical brands and strengthening its core businesses, he has firmly established himself within the team.

Ayurvedic Treatments - Your Answer to all Health Issues: The human body is made up of three components as per Ayurveda - Vata, Pitta, and Kapha.
